channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-133323 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-103406 — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

item.title: CVE-2026-133469 — Vates Xen Orchestra
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

item.title: CVE-2026-133303 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

item.title: CVE-2023-25914 — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

item.title: CVE-2023-25915 — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2025-41450 — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

item.title: CVE-2026-133324 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

item.title: CVE-2026-133275 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

item.title: CVE-2026-133311 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.
